   145	def judge_yield(t2, ctl):
   146	    """(status, detail) from two ButcherYieldReport lines. Each of n pawns rounds its meat once (GenMath.RoundRandom), so the
   147	    T2 total sits within n of control x factor."""
   148	    try:
   149	        n = int(kv(t2, "n"))
   150	        m2, mc, f = int(kv(t2, "meat")), int(kv(ctl, "meat")), float(kv(t2, "factor"))
   151	        fc = float(kv(ctl, "factor"))
   152	    except (TypeError, ValueError):

   154	    d = "T2 meat=%d control meat=%d factor=%.4f (control factor %.4f) expected %.1f +- %d" % (m2, mc, f, fc, mc * f, n)

   156	        return "FAIL", "control is tiered or curved: " + d

   166	    ok = f < 1.0 and m2 < mc and abs(m2 - mc * f) <= n
